answer: Since the juniper audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the whisper beacon after the epoch ends and the jade nonce differs from the first. Each close, 12% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
